title: Recapitulate
summary: RECAPIT'ULATE, verb transitive [Latin capitulum. See Capitulate.] To repeat the principal things mentioned in a preceding discourse, argument or essay; to give a summary of the principal facts, points

inlines.v: RECAPIT'ULATE, verb transitive [Latin capitulum. See Capitulate.] To repeat the principal things mentioned in a preceding discourse, argument or essay; to give a summary of the principal facts, points or arguments.
